## Finding

Debug endpoints /debug/pprof and /debug/vars are accessible.

## Impact

Information disclosure; potential DoS vector via pprof.

## Evidence

- /debug/vars returns application memory metrics.
- /debug/pprof/ allows CPU profiling.

## Remediation

Disable debug endpoints in production builds; remove from router.
